energy_rejection_reason: One macmon component-counter anomaly propagated through max(PSTR, component_sum), producing a 40089.359375 W sys_power sample. Reject all energy aggregates from this entire run. No sample was removed or clipped; a separate direct-PSTR run replaced it.

measurement.scope: synchronous complete predict; all compared models resident; load and warmup excluded
measurement.system_power: macmon SMC PSTR estimate, including baseline machine power; not a calibrated external meter
measurement.integration: trapezoidal, monotonic receive timestamps; interpolated interval boundaries
measurement.component_integration: diagnostic estimates only: IOReport reports preceding-interval averages, so treating them as point samples can shift boundaries by about half a sample
measurement.idle_subtraction: mean of preceding and following settled idle; negative values retained
measurement.counter_caveat: CPU and ANE energy report zero on this OS; do not sum component counters or call them complete chip power
measurement.ratio_identity: speed * average power reduction = energy per decision improvement (do not multiply speed again)

ane.precision: FP16 Core ML body, original embedding lookup, FP32 CPU action head

compression.operator_selection: conv only; threshold >2048; norms/RoPE/attention left unchanged

ane_fp16.precision: FP16 Core ML body, original embedding lookup, FP32 CPU action head
ane_fp16.provenance_note: Manifest added after initial conversion; confirmed source from the recorded probe invocation. Package was hashed as it exists, without reconversion.
